solutions.title: Three-family adversarial prompt attack
solutions.summary: The 7th-place Solution partitions essays across three targeted prompt attacks, repeats a selected batch, and uses seeded swaps to stabilize the final private score.

competition.name: LLMs - You Can't Please Them All

preprocessing.text: Neutral random-word sequences and topic-conditioned essay templates form the attack inputs.

inference.text: Rows are partitioned across three prompt-attack families aimed at different judge behaviors.

postprocessing.text: A selected 18-row batch is repeated, then specific essays are swapped before export.

ensembling.text: Three attack families are distributed across the submission rather than relying on one exploit.
